title: Hoe (DS)

{{Item |image=[[File:Hoe (FoMT).png]] |name=Hoe |obtain by=Starting Tool }} The '''Hoe''' is an essential tool in [[Harvest Moon DS]], which is available in the inventory immediately. It is used to till farmland for planting [[Crops (DS)|Crops]], and remove planted seeds and cut grass. ==Upgrades== {|border="1" cellpadding="1" cellspacing="1" style="width:500px;text-align:center;" ! style="width:10%;background-color:rgb(123, 204, 112);"|Type ! style="width:10%;background-color:rgb(123, 204, 112);"|Range ! style="width:10%;background-color:rgb(123, 204, 112);"|Stamina Usage ! style="width:10%;background-color:rgb(123, 204, 112);"|Description |- | [[File:Hoe (FoMT).png]]
